description: Source code implementing DER parsing functions for ASN.1 data types, including booleans, integers, time formats, and string types, used in cryptographic and network security contexts.

classes.name: BitString
classes.description: Represents a DER-encoded bit string with methods to validate and assert bits.

classes.name: GeneralizedTime
classes.description: Represents a generalized time structure with comparison operators and validation methods.

methods.name: ParseBool
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseBoolRelaxed
methods.description: Parses a boolean value with relaxed BER interpretation.

methods.name: IsValidInteger
methods.description: Checks if an input is a valid ASN.1 integer and determines if it is negative.

methods.name: ParseUint64
methods.description: Parses a 64-bit unsigned integer from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseUint8
methods.description: Parses an 8-bit unsigned integer from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseUTCTime
methods.description: Parses a UTC time string into a GeneralizedTime object.

methods.name: ParseGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Parses a generalized time string into a GeneralizedTime object.

methods.name: ParseIA5String
methods.description: Parses an IA5 string (ASCII) from input.

methods.name: ParseVisibleString
methods.description: Parses a visible string (printable ASCII) from input.

methods.name: ParsePrintableString
methods.description: Parses a printable string with specific character restrictions.

methods.name: ParseTeletexStringAsLatin1
methods.description: Converts a Teletex string to Latin-1 (UTF-8).

methods.name: ParseUniversalString
methods.description: Parses a UCS-4 encoded universal string.

methods.name: ParseBmpString
methods.description: Parses a UCS-2 encoded BMP string.
